subject.title: Telegram: /commands in forum topics bypass groupPolicy disabled and trigger all bots

question: Should the native Telegram command repair silently drop commands when the effective topic/group `groupPolicy` is disabled, rather than sending a denial reply from non-owning bots?
rationale: This is an authorization-boundary bug, and the prior one-line fix path reaches a visible denial branch instead of proving the non-owning bot ignore behavior requested by the issue.

options.title: Repair Native Commands Separately
options.body: Fix the native slash-command path to honor topic/group policy overrides and silently drop disabled-topic commands, then validate with focused tests and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Adopt And Rework The Fork PR
options.body: Use the open fork PR only as source context, but require a revised patch that handles disabled-topic silent drops and proof before landing.

options.title: Fold Into Callback Authorization Work
options.body: Ask maintainers to combine this native-command fix with the open `/models` callback authorization work, accepting a broader mixed security review.

recommendation.title: Repair Native Commands Separately
recommendation.body: Fix the native slash-command path to honor topic/group policy overrides and silently drop disabled-topic commands, then validate with focused tests and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest recent history signal for native-command authorization and adjacent group-auth tests.
